osaka_panaf_african_restaurant_club.notes: [African · Amerikamura, the Expo's African restaurant, now a buffet with live music] The African restaurant that drew crowds at the 2025 Osaka Expo, reopened on the 7th floor of Big Step in Amerikamura and since October 2026 a buffet: ¥2,000 at lunch, ¥3,800 at dinner, with a terrace and live African music every night. Try the peanut-rich mafe stew, Kenyan kebab, kataifi shrimp and the rice dishes, and a baobab or bissap juice. Diners in 2026 found it great value and fun; some found the entry queue disorganised, the soups sour or the popular dishes gone at peak times. On Friday and Saturday nights it turns into a club until 5:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an African buffet restaurant with live performances, blending traditional African culture with contemporary flavours, with dishes that were a hit at the Expo; buffet from 2 October 2026; opened 24 March 2026. October 2026 reviewers describe it as the African restaurant from the Osaka Kansai Expo.
chef_bio.philosophy: Refined African dishes that break the stereotype of Africa (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: "I especially loved the Mafe, a rich beef stew made with peanut butter, which had a wonderful buttery aroma." — October 2026, buffet with craft beer ¥6,500.

Kaiseki courses: Umai kaiseki ¥6,600, Ookini course ¥7,700, Tenkomori with fugu, Kobe beef and Ise lobster ¥13,200 (Tabelog). BYO drinks allowed; children's lunch sets and meals on request (Tabelog). osaka_yamatoya_honten_shimanouchi.notes: [Kaiseki · Shimanouchi, seasonal Kansai kaiseki by the Dotonbori River] A large Japanese restaurant (and inn) on the Dotonbori River just across Nipponbashi, with fully private rooms for anything from two to a hundred guests, popular for company trips and New Year parties. Courses follow the season: kue hot pot in winter, hamo in summer, Kobe beef, fugu, and a ¥13,200 boat-platter feast of fugu, Kobe beef and Ise lobster. Diners praise the sashimi and the private rooms; several found the service rushed or ordinary for the setting, and one found the abalone disappointing (July 2026). Menus in four languages; lunch and dinner daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: by the Dotonbori River, serving seasonal dishes from carefully selected ingredients so guests can taste Kansai's "shun"; rooms for groups of 2 to 100. An April 2026 reviewer describes staying at Yamatoya as a ryokan with a public bath; June 2026 reviewers came on a company trip.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal kaiseki; fugu and kue hot pots.

anecdotes.text: "I was particularly impressed by the Kue hot pot, which had a superb broth and wonderfully tender texture." — December 2024, the kue kaiseki at lunch.
"The MVP was the flounder wrapped in paper." — June 2026, a company trip.
"We also had abalone, but it tasted more like tokobushi." — July 2026, a company-trip dinner.

osaka_osteria_pantera_shinsaibashi.notes: [Italian · Shinsaibashi, an all-day osteria by Daimaru] A stylish osteria a minute from Daimaru Shinsaibashi, open from morning to late night, with fresh pasta at lunch and small plates and over 50 wines in the evening. osaka_tachizushi_sugio_nishinakajima.notes: [Sushi · Nishinakajima, a standing sushi bar open past 2 a.m.] A bright, lively standing sushi bar in an alley near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where the chefs make each piece in front of you and you order one at a time, from ¥132 (Tabelog). It is open until 2:30, a favourite last stop before the final train (September–October 2026). Opinions vary on value; some found it pricey for the quality (July 2026). Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog shop text: a casual standing sushi bar two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, where skilled chefs make authentic sushi in front of you with attention to freshness, thickness and preparation of the toppings. Reviewers: reliable, lively service (July 2026); a known spot in the area for years (September 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Freshness, thickness and preparation of the toppings (Tabelog shop text).

osaka_komeya_cocoya_nishinakajima.notes: [Izakaya · Nishinakajima, an izakaya where the rice is the star] An izakaya near Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2004, run around rice: the owner, a certified rice taster, chooses the grain, and it is cooked in a clay pot to order, glossy and sweet (shop site; 2026). Pair it with 40–50 junmai sakes and dishes made for rice, such as salt-koji kara-age, chicken nanban and the house mapo curry (2026). Lunch is a ¥1,000 kara-age and pork-soup set; dinner courses run about ¥4,500 (2026). Smoking is allowed, so no children.

chef_bio.background: Shop site: COCOYA (※米屋) is an izakaya themed on enjoying rice; the owner is a certified rice and taste appraiser (米・食味鑑定士) and buys rice selected at a five-star rice meister's shop in the city; the rice is cooked in a clay pot made for rice; 40–50 junmai sakes; the mapo curry was featured on Kansai TV programmes in 2019. Opened 3 April 2004 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: The appeal of rice beyond plain white rice (shop site).

osaka_kawakita_shoten_shin_osaka.notes: [Yakitori · Shin-Osaka Station, mince skewers and a long happy hour] A busy yakitori counter in the food hall by the subway exit at Shin-Osaka Station, popular with travellers killing time before the Shinkansen, thanks to a happy hour from 11:00 to 18:00 with drinks from ¥290 (October 2026). Stairs are narrow and steep (March and October 2026). Opened 1 May 2019 (Tabelog).
osaka_hoshizora_kitchen_nova.notes: [Italian · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, creative Italian until 5 a.m.] A two-storey Italian bar three minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, with a long, high-ceilinged counter downstairs and hideaway sofa rooms above in a space the shop says was designed by Tadao Ando. It runs from 6 p.m. to 5 a.m., so it serves both early dinners and late-night wine with an appetizer platter (the mackerel with white-miso eggplant sauce stands out). Diners praise the Bolognese, carbonara and shrimp bread and the friendly staff; courses suit birthdays and girls' nights but keep a strict two-hour limit. Mind the narrow, steep stairs: one October 2026 diner sprained an ankle. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: casual creative Italian and wine; reservation-only courses; a two-storey designer space that the listing says was designed by the architect Tadao Ando, with a long counter on 1F and private sofa seating above; opened 1 May 2019.

anecdotes.text: "Everything was delicious, but the Bolognese was exceptionally good!" — April 2026.
"The mackerel was served with a sauce made from dried tomatoes, eggplant, and white miso." — October 2026, at the bar until 5 a.m.
"Also, be careful of the steps; I tripped and ended up spraining my ankle, which required a visit to the hospital." — October 2026.

osaka_cafe_mode_minamihorie.notes: [Café · Minami-Horie, an all-day café over Horie Park] A bright white café on the third floor of a building facing Horie Park, with big windows onto the trees, and cherry blossoms in spring. It serves lunch sets all day, from a Kobe beef steak assiette and a filler-free hamburg to beef stew, pasta and avocado toast, plus an evening set of pork shabu-shabu or simmered flounder. The cakes are the other reason to come: the pear cake, a light mille-feuille, and a gluten-free caramel pear tart one March 2026 diner enjoyed (ask, as the menu changes). Dogs are welcome inside. Order and pay at the counter. Closed Mondays.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog: café, Italian and steak on 3F of the 中澤唐木ビル by Horie Park; lunch sets all day; private hire up to 120; ingredients and suppliers may change with weather and logistics. Reviews (March–September 2026): an Italian café in a bright, bridal-feeling space by the park.

anecdotes.text: "The caramel tart with pear was surprisingly delicious for being gluten-free." — March 2026.
"From the large windows, I could see the cherry blossoms in the park, which was absolutely lovely." — April 2026.
"Dogs are welcome inside the restaurant." — September 2026.

osaka_yakiniku_house_tarareba_nishinakaj.notes: [Yakiniku · Minamikata, whole-cow Kagoshima wagyu over charcoal] A 35-seat yakiniku house two minutes from Hankyu Minamikata, opened in 2024, that buys whole Kagoshima black wagyu, A5 female cattle, and grills it over charcoal. That means rare cuts like misuji and kainomi alongside thick tongue and a big sukiyaki-style ribeye with egg yolk; brave diners also order tongue or harami sashimi (2026). Solo diners get half portions at the ground-floor counter; groups sit upstairs on sunken kotatsu, with courses from ¥4,500. Order by tablet. Open to 23:00; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: yakiniku and offal; opened 2 September 2024. Per reviews: "specializes in Kagoshima A5 rank black-haired Wagyu beef with a BMS score of 10 or higher" (September 2026); whole-cattle buying gives "rare parts that are hard to find elsewhere" (August 2026); "the staff provides excellent service, always smiling and accommodating even when dealing with tipsy patrons" (September 2026); a regular on the fifteenth visit (September 2026); one diner booked the counter and was seated upstairs (October 2026); upstairs table chairs bump together (September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Whole-cow Kagoshima A5 wagyu; tongue three ways.

anecdotes.text: "A beautiful assortment featuring cuts like Haneshita, Kurimi, Misuji, and Kainomi, all showcasing exquisite marbling." — August 2026, five rare cuts.

osaka_shiki_shizen_tachibana_shin_osaka.notes: [Izakaya · Shin-Osaka, a big Japanese banquet house with homemade tofu] A 200-seat Japanese restaurant on the second floor of the Nissei building, reached under cover from Shin-Osaka exit 4, with private rooms and a tatami hall for 120. Its pride is homemade tofu: at lunch, sets of sashimi or dashimaki and tempura come with zaru or chilled tofu and free refills of tofu, rice and soup, around ¥1,450–1,600 (2025–2026). Evenings turn to banquet courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥5,000, sashimi and seasonal Osaka water eggplant. Busy with office workers at noon. Open to 23:00 on weekdays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: izakaya, seafood and fugu; particular about fish; health menu; private rooms; reached directly from Shin-Osaka exit 4 "without worrying about rain". A second shop in Umeda (Hilton Plaza, per Hot Pepper; "I had been to Tachibana in Umeda for dinner before", July 2026). Per reviews: "The signature dish, homemade tofu, boasts a smooth texture and rich soybean flavor" (June 2026); "even after the all-you-can-drink time was over, I could extend it for an hour by ordering a la carte" (June 2026); the tatami room suited a family with a baby (August 2026); one diner found the overseas staff short on smiles (July 2026).

anecdotes.text: "I imagined the cold zaru tofu, so I was surprised when it was warm! But eating it with the dashi was refreshing." — June 2026, simmered fish set.
"Chilled tofu, rice, and soup are all refillable." — September 2026.
"The seasonal water eggplant from Osaka was delicious." — June 2026.
